module: Flowgraph node "Mission End Screen" (category once_instant, singleActive): mission end screen with default and custom buttons (UI navigation 'scenario.end'). Inputs: "text" (string or table), "failed", "change", "progressKey", "customBtnsFirst" (custom buttons before the default ones). Outputs: "retry", "contStart" (continue at the start of the mission), "contHere" (continue here; in career only with its vehicle), plus, for each custom button, an input pin (label), a "<name>_active" pin (hidden bool) and a flow output pin. Default buttons: next missions, Retry, Continue at start (or Scenarios), Continue here.
notes: Showing two of these at the same time will break everything (todo from the code).
openDialogue reads career_career.isActive() without checking that career_career exists (isTutorial): error if the career extension is not loaded.
In the career tutorial, only the "Continue here" buttons remain.
On retry, onResetGameplay sets "retry" to true before closing.

buttonPushed.desc: Sets the output pin of the clicked button to true (without resetting the others to false) and closes the screen.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editing of the custom button list.

getCmd.desc: Returns the Lua command that calls buttonPushed(action) back.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

onNodeReset.desc: Closes the screen and resets the outputs to false.

onResetGameplay.desc: Hook: sets retry to true and closes the screen if Retry is enabled.

openDialogue.desc: Builds the button list and the mission data, then navigates to 'scenario.end'.

updateButtons.desc: Recreates the pins (text, active, output) per option, restoring the links.
